checkpoints.description: [1/2] Cache settings serialization for reused cachedAnswers grouping keys

impact_assessment.benefits: Serialize each reused settings object once per history cache with a bounded LRU-style FIFO and preserve group output exactly
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first hit/eviction counter tests, cachedAnswers and tune-runs suites, benchmark and strict gates; revert on any group change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: key string and grouping order unchanged; dependency: WeakMap; concurrency: process-local per-cache; state: bound and reset with the history cache
impact_assessment.why: cachedAnswers reuses parsed row objects from the history cache but still JSON.stringify each row's settings on every call just to rebuild the same grouping key

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Persist a history.jsonl import byte offset in SQLite

impact_assessment.benefits: Read only appended bytes, skip an unchanged prefix and keep rebuild/truncation safe
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first appended-bytes test, rebuild/truncation tests, report A/B, full npm suite and strict gates
impact_assessment.risks: contract: run and link results stay identical; dependency: node:sqlite state table; concurrency: single process local; state: invalidate on truncation, rewrite, inode change or fewer database rows

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Add a short TTL around positive receipt stat validation

impact_assessment.benefits: Skip repeat stat calls within a one-second window while keeping writer invalidation and stamp validation on expiry
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first stat-counter test, invalidation tests, 200-receipt A/B, full npm suite and strict gates
impact_assessment.risks: contract: edited receipts are still detected after TTL or invalidation; dependency: Date.now via injectable clock; concurrency: process-local cache; state: TTL stored per cached receipt
impact_assessment.why: Present receipts are cached but every API poll still stats each sidecar to validate them; 200 receipts cost about 5ms per poll on this host

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Cache evaluator load signatures per settings object and width

impact_assessment.benefits: Compute the load object and model/context signatures once per candidate/width while preserving all load/reconfigure decisions
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, evaluator/tune tests, 1000-measure A/B and strict gates; revert on any load/reconfigure difference
